name: Nagybarca (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagybarca: a white and green shield with a bunch of grapes and a sickle, with an oak bough crest, above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYBARCA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagybarca arms with crest and scroll
